provenance.method: non-mutating local version, help, exit-status, and binary-digest probes
provenance.normalization: Raw outputs were summarized; absolute paths, identities, credentials, environment values, and private configuration were excluded.
provenance.digest_recommendation: For a future retained evidence set, serialize each sanitized {argv,exit_code,stdout,stderr} record canonically, hash each record with SHA-256, then hash the sorted digest manifest. Hash normal and experimental schema bundles separately and bind both manifests to the exact CLI binary digest.
